_comment: Copy to discord_poller_config.json and fill in. Token + channel IDs are sensitive — keep the actual file out of git (already in .gitignore-friendly name).
_token_help: Browser DevTools -> Network -> any Discord API call -> Request Headers -> Authorization. NO 'Bot ' prefix for user tokens.
_channel_help: Right-click channel in Discord -> Copy Channel ID. Requires Developer Mode enabled (Settings -> Advanced).
_out_csv_help: Target inbox CSV in MT4/MT5 Files folder. EA will tail this file. Path above is the Axi MT4 terminal.
_state_help: Stores last-seen Discord message ID per channel and the next 'our msg id' counter. Safe to delete to re-pull recent history.
_poll_help: 5s = ~5s max latency from Discord post to EA. Discord rate limit is ~50 req/sec global; 2 channels * 1 req per cycle = 2 req per 5s = 0.4 req/sec, plenty of headroom.
